items.summary: CFO recommendation: preserve containment and approve no new spend, budget commitment, monetization expansion, revenue forecast, ROI claim, or contribution-margin claim. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. All commission is aggregate tracking_id=other; named site rows show $0 attributed commission. Site revenue, margin, CAC, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. Retain only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after one delivery slot is released and site overlap clears.

AI spend is measurable but cost-to-learn is not calculable. On 2026-10-01, 16 AI calls cost $2.2785467 across 4 of 38 expected sites; 34 sites lack AI-cost coverage and no incremental validated outcome is available. Infrastructure, fixed, marketing, labor, and monthly spend limits are blank, so total budget exposure, contribution margin, and payback cannot be calculated. Minimum measurement: site-level AI/infrastructure/direct-change cost plus a verified incremental revenue or conversion outcome for the same measurement window.

Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request only after the current repair case releases one slot and site overlap clears. Use the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. For 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks, record affiliate clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, direct change cost, allocated AI cost, and allocated infrastructure cost. Contribution margin equals attributable commission less directly attributable costs; if site-level commission or cost allocation is unavailable, classify margin and ROI as unknown. Do not treat impressions, clicks, audited actions, or improvements started as financial performance.
